# CaribbeanCodeStudios

> High-performance, affordable web design and development in Trinidad and Tobago.

## About
CaribbeanCodeStudios specializes in modern web solutions for small businesses in T&T. We emphasize full website ownership, speed, and premium aesthetics using a modern tech stack (Netlify, Supabase, Google Gemini).

## Services
- [Affordable Web Design Trinidad](https://caribbeancodestudios.com/affordable-web-design-trinidad): High-performance static websites starting at TT$2,500.
- [Website Development Services](https://caribbeancodestudios.com/website-development-trinidad): Tailored responsive and interactive website builds for Trinidadian businesses.
- [Our Projects](https://caribbeancodestudios.com/projects): Digital portfolio highlighting our real client sites: The Fuel Haus TT, Charming Choices TT, and Barberlink TT.
- [About CaribbeanCodeStudios](https://caribbeancodestudios.com/about): Discover our mission, values, and Port of Spain based team.

## Key Differentiators
- **One-Day Website Build**: Optimized workflows for fast delivery in Trinidad.
- **No Lock-In**: Customers own their code and assets.
- **AI-Powered**: Utilizing Google Gemini and ChatGPT for advanced development.
